business_problem: As a cloud-native internet bank, BaiXin Bank needed a resilient private-cloud and data architecture that could support fast product iteration, distributed and microservice-based operations, regulatory requirements, and future AI-led financial services without inheriting the baggage of traditional banking infrastructure.
solution_summary: BaiXin Bank and Baidu AI Cloud jointly built a 'Financial Brain' centered on all-cloud banking architecture, private-cloud infrastructure, and a bank-wide data strategy. The implementation combines Baidu's Financial Intelligence and Financial Data Services capabilities with a distributed cloud architecture and microservice governance framework so the bank can run core and non-core systems on elastic infrastructure from the outset. Baidu and BaiXin also built big-data platform infrastructure and performed enterprise-wide data architecture planning to unify data acquisition, model building, data-quality control, and downstream analytics for marketing, management, and product operations. Every business system is expected to provide data deliverability, letting operational data accumulate into reusable banking assets under regulatory controls.

solution_components.name: Financial Intelligence
solution_components.role: Provides the AI-oriented banking capability layer used to connect cloud infrastructure with intelligent products and services.

solution_components.name: Financial Data Services
solution_components.role: Supports the bank-wide data architecture, model construction, and quality-governance workflows behind BaiXin's data-driven strategy.

solution_components.name: Financial Brain
solution_components.role: Acts as the combined cloud-and-data operating model that exposes intelligent services internally and externally.

data_flow: Business systems deliver operational data into BaiXin's cloud-based data architecture, where acquisition, modeling, and quality-control processes are unified. The resulting data assets support market analysis, management decisions, product design, operations, and later AI-driven financial scenarios.
business_outcome: BaiXin Bank established an all-cloud operating foundation for intelligent banking, ran dozens of systems stably with no major incidents, passed regulatory acceptance, and created a data-first base for AI-powered financial products and risk control.
metrics: More than 39 business systems run on the all-cloud architecture.
More than 60% of employees are in the technology and big-data teams.
9 non-business systems also run on the platform.
Since launch, there have been zero level-5 or above operational incidents.
There have been zero security incidents.
architecture_clues: The bank built an enterprise-grade distributed cloud architecture and microservice governance framework
All business systems are expected to have data deliverability so information becomes durable bank assets
The operating model combines private cloud, data governance, and an AI-finance joint laboratory
evidence_quotes: BaiXin Bank and Baidu jointly built a 'Financial Brain' and one of the industry's rare full-cloud architectures (original: 百信银行与百度智能云联合打造“百信金融大脑”…构建了全行业为数不多的全云架构).

Baidu and the bank built big-data platform infrastructure and unified management of data acquisition, model building, and data-quality control (original: 与百度智能云共同构建大数据平台的基础设施建设…对数据获取、模型建设、数据质量管控进行统一管理).

BaiXin completed regulatory acceptance, ran 39 business systems and 9 non-business systems stably, and reported zero level-5 incidents and zero security incidents (original: 实现了企业级分布式云架构和微服务治理框架，并且顺利完成监管验收…39个业务系统和9个非业务系统…没有五级以上的运行事故，目前无一起安全事故).
